description: Fetch one UK ONS time series (the classic timeseries API, distinct from the filterable datasets above). Pass EITHER `code` (the 4-letter series ID / CDID such as "EAWP" or "ABMI", optionally with `dataset_id` such as "DRSI" when a CDID is published in several datasets; a bare dataset code such as "PN2" returns that dataset's series list to pick a CDID from) OR `uri` (the www.ons.gov.uk path, e.g. "/economy/grossdomesticproductgdp/timeseries/abmi/pn2"). Returns the full series JSON (description + years/quarters/months observations) plus `latest`, the most recent observation. (Named ons_timeseries, get_series is used by many other economic-data packs.)

code.description: ONS series ID (CDID), e.g. "EAWP", "ABMI", "MGSX". A dataset code (e.g. "PN2") lists that dataset's series instead.

dataset_id.description: Optional dataset code to disambiguate a CDID published in several datasets, e.g. "PN2" or "UKEA".

uri.description: ONS timeseries URI, e.g. "/economy/grossdomesticproductgdp/timeseries/abmi/pn2". Used instead of `code`.

name: ons_timeseries
title: Ons Timeseries
